faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment drive is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) for a project-based research position in Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Research Associate under the project titled 'ML4EDA: Next Generation AI-Assisted Chip Design' in the department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position in this project-based recruitment notification issued by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree in a relevant area, or M.Tech./M.E. with at least 3 years of research experience in CSE, ECE, or a related discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a total consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 70,850.00, which includes the recommended pay, HRA, and medical allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Guwahati Research Associate recruitment is 13-10-2026.

faq.question: Q7. When is the online interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The online interview for the shortlisted candidates who applied for the Research Associate vacancy is scheduled to take place on 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT Guwahati Research Associate?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates must submit their applications through online mode by visiting the official Recruitment Portal of IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply for this post?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or mentioned in the official advertisement released by the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: You can check the Important Links section of this article to access the direct links for the official notification PDF, online application portal, and IIT Guwahati website.
